# Variable `WIRELESS_DAEMON`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

For `connman` and `packagegroup-base`, specifies the wireless daemon to use. The default is “wpa-supplicant” (note that the value uses a dash and not an underscore).

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-WIRELESS_DAEMON)
